Protein Quality in Animal Feeding
The importance of protein in animal nutrition has been recognized for a long time, but only during recent years has the quality of the protein been studied in any detail and its importance in the feeding of animals been realized.
the quality of the protein source is more important than quantity in determining the response to protein supplementation of a basal diet of low-quality protein.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: 1. The determination of protein requirements of animals. 2. The determination of the protein value of feedingstuffs. 3. The development and application of methods for assessing the quality of protein concentrates.
the following aspects of protein nutrition: (1) The determination of the protein requirements of animals and the evaluation of protein quality.

the following: (1) The development of methods for determining the quality of protein in feedingstuffs, (2) The use of the results of these tests to improve the quality of feeding-stuffs, and (3) The development of practical rationing systems for farm animals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality of the protein is a factor that is not to be overlooked in the formulation of rations for the intensive feeding of non-ruminal animals.
the protein quality of a feedstuff is a measure of its ability to satisfy the protein needs of the animal.

the protein quality of concentrates for non-ruminant animals is a function of the essential amino acid content and that the amino acid composition of the concentrate should approximate as closely as possible that of the protein of the animal's tissues.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
protein quality in animal feeds can be assessed in terms of the amino acid composition, the digestibility and the availability.
the quality of protein in animal feedingstuffs is a function of the amino-acid composition and of the digestibility of the protein.
protein quality is an essential consideration for practical rations, and that the protein quality of concentrates is an important factor that must be taken into account in the formulation of rations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the protein quality of the diet is a key driver of the health benefits of a high-protein diet.
we have a better understanding of how protein quality influences the growth of the animals.
